title: Trend Radar
subtitle: What is trending and making news in your market, ready to become content
intro: This page gathers, around the clock, what is trending and making news in JPN Hardwood Floors's world. Each card comes with an angle ready to turn into a Reel. Approve the ones you want to produce, dismiss the ones that do not fit, and leave a comment anytime. It updates on its own.
video_queries: hardwood floor refinishing before and after

voice.quem: JPN Hardwood Floors, a family-run hardwood flooring craftsman serving Medford and the Greater Boston area, specializing in installation, dustless sanding, refinishing and full restoration of real wood floors.
voice.eixo_viral: The dramatic transformation: a tired, scratched or dated wood floor brought back to life, showing the craft, the finish and the real-home result that makes a house feel new again.
voice.tom: Warm, confident master-craftsman authority: technical expertise explained simply, proud of the trade, honest about what real wood needs, never salesy, always making the homeowner feel their floor is in expert hands.
voice.gancho_formula: [Curiosity or pain about a wood floor] + [surprising truth or transformation] + [the JPN way to get it done right].
voice.gancho_default: THIS 80 YEAR OLD FLOOR WAS HIDING UNDER THE CARPET THE WHOLE TIME
voice.alvo_default: Greater Boston homeowners with real hardwood floors

alvo.homeowners: Homeowners in older New England houses with worn or hidden hardwood floors
alvo.renovators: People renovating or flipping a home who want floors that boost resale value
alvo.new_installs: Homeowners choosing new hardwood for a fresh build or remodel
alvo.realtors: Realtors and property managers who need floors ready to sell fast

voice.angulo_corpo: Show the real work and the real result: the state of the floor before, the craft (sanding, staining, finishing) and the finished room, tying each step to why it matters for a wood floor that lasts decades.
voice.angulo_corpo_video: Fast satisfying transformation cut: dull scratched floor, the sanding reveal, the color going on, the glossy or matte finish, then a slow pan of the finished room, with short on-screen captions explaining each stage in plain English.
voice.angulo_fecho: Invite the Greater Boston homeowner to picture their own floor transformed and reach out to JPN for a free estimate, done right, on time and dust-free.
